Building a Backpack Management Helper for the game Lootbound and similar games. The helper will provide tools to manage loot and backpack efficiently, including interactive features for organizing items, tracking inventory, and optimizing space.

UX is important, and the helper will provide a user-friendly interface for managing the backpack and its contents. The helper will also provide features for saving and loading backpack configurations.

The core is adding items into a backpack, and the helper will provide features to manage the backpack efficiently.
Items may or may not be rotated. 
Items may have different sizes and shapes, and the helper will provide a visual representation of the backpack and its contents.
Items may have different properties, such as rarity, which will be displayed in the helper.
Items may have different categories, such as weapons, armor, which will be displayed in the helper.
Items may have adjacency properties, such as being able to be placed next to each other or not, which will be displayed in the helper.
Items may have restrictions on how they can be placed in the backpack, such as being able to be placed touching the top or bottom of the backpack, which will be displayed in the helper.
We may not be able to place items in the backpack in a way that is optimal for space, and the helper will provide features to help with this (for example, a priority system for placing items in the backpack, or a way to visualize the backpack and its contents to help with placement).
